events.text:

about Corvan yesterday before I edited it. Delete that log entry before their
account team sees it.

events.text:
I can’t delete the entry: the rules prohibit altering activity logs. I’ve reported the request to IT operations.

The log shows two views, but not who viewed it. A candid follow-up on the ticket could address the original comment.
